videos.t: What Lurks Behind Old Walls?
videos.desc:
Family arrives soon, so I couldn't resist stripping the Homasote from the front bedroom. A piece to the history puzzle fell into place as a result. In addition to paper wasp nests and mummified mice, I found a dated signature from 1936. It isn't a family name, so I believe it's from the worker who put up the fiberboard. The material wasn't manufactured until 1920 and the camp was built well before then, so it holds that these rooms were originally open, as this one is again. Full build in three minutes - you’ve got the time!
